name: Icon wallpaper converges into a category row
looks: A dense tiled wallpaper of small line-icons (tiny garments and baby items) sits behind a bold headline naming the scale of the problem. It cuts to a light field where five of those same icons fly in from scattered positions and settle into a neat horizontal row of labelled category cards.
build: The wallpaper is a repeating background pattern, static but filling the frame. The convergence tweens each icon's x/y from a seeded scattered start to its slot in the row, power3.out, staggered 0.05-0.08s apart, landing inside a small rounded card with its label fading in last.
sound: A low textured hum under the wallpaper, then a soft tick per icon landing in its slot.
prompt: Show overwhelming variety resolving into order: hold on a dense wallpaper of small related icons behind a headline naming the scale, then let a handful of those icons fly in from scattered positions and settle into one neat labelled row.
